gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-tirra: Chunky, bendy, hand-cut letters up top with no pinched curves anywhere. Tirra follows in sans-serif form, its round shapes like open parentheses, which is the quiet counterweight that makes the loud heading feel intentional.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-titillium-web: Every stroke in Balsamiq Sans keeps one measured thickness, like a bent paperclip. Titillium Web, a plain sans with stroke ends set far apart, carries a longer passage with an approachable, easy-going feel.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-tomorrow: Tomorrow reads clean, its bowls opening like a cupped palm. Give that plain sans a generous size and it lets the bent-paperclip lines of Balsamiq Sans stay the loud part.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-trispace: Trispace reads sparse and widely set, its curves opening outward rather than curling in. Bump the size of that plain sans a notch, and it holds its own beside the bent-tubing letterforms of Balsamiq Sans.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-tuffy: Balsamiq Sans draws its letters with the constant weight of a stencil-cut channel, never pinching a curve. Tuffy, a sans-serif sketched by a pencil that never presses harder, reads smoothly over a long page.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-urbanist: Balsamiq Sans never pinches a curve, bending like tubing. Its strongest quality is how that loud, uniform line sits against Urbanist, a sans with the single-width trail of a rolling-ball pen.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-varela: Balsamiq Sans holds the constant weight of a stencil-cut channel through every bend and curve. Varela, a plain sans with wide-mouthed c shapes, makes a long read feel friendly.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-varela-round: Varela Round is modern and clean, with wide-mouthed rounds. Make the heading small or the body large, and Balsamiq Sans loses its bold, expressive edge against this sans.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-varta: Varta reads open and contemporary, with big eyes on every e and a. Its best quality is how that sans-serif keeps quiet while Balsamiq Sans holds every stroke at one measured thickness.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-wix-madefor-disp: Rounded, bold and bendy, Balsamiq Sans has walls as heavy on its curves as on straight strokes. And Wix Madefor Display, a plain sans with gently flared curve ends, simply handles the quieter reading.
